At different floors, replicas may retain different expired records while rejecting the same revoked lineage. Equality of retained sets is claimed only after normalization to a common floor and delivery of all still-relevant admitted events. Weakly connected propagation in Bayou~\cite{bayoupropagation} and epidemic exchange~\cite{epidemic} motivate delivery assumptions, not an authorization theorem.

\subsection{Authorization languages and protected data}
Trust-management systems such as PolicyMaker~\cite{blaze1996}, SD3~\cite{sd3}, Binder~\cite{binder2002}, and SecPAL~\cite{secpal} make decentralized policy evaluation explicit. Role-based trust management~\cite{rt2002} and delegation logic~\cite{delegationlogic} address richer policy relations than our single-parent algebra. SPKI formalizes certificate delegation~\cite{spki}. Relationship-based models~\cite{fongrebac,brunsrebac}, Zanzibar's consistent authorization service~\cite{zanzibar}, and Cedar's policy language~\cite{cedar} further separate expressiveness and consistency concerns from revocation completion. We do not compare policy-language coverage or decision speed across these different semantics.

\subsection{Consistency, time, and recovery}
Disconnected operation in Coda~\cite{coda}, conflict management in Bayou~\cite{bayouconflicts}, and highly available storage in Dynamo~\cite{dynamo} explain why delayed information must be an explicit assumption. COPS~\cite{cops} and Eiger~\cite{eiger} address causal semantics; hybrid clocks~\cite{hlc} and GentleRain~\cite{gentlerain} expose different uses of physical time. Their consistency guarantees do not automatically imply exclusion of a revoked ancestor. Coordination avoidance~\cite{coordavoid}, Indigo~\cite{indigo}, and Quelea~\cite{quelea} connect invariants to coordination requirements, whereas our invariant is tied to a particular authorization algebra and observation boundary.
